basic_attack._note: Slow, but her main source of mana: about 10 mana a second while she attacks.
basic_attack.name: Lantern Glow
basic_attack.text: Throws lantern light at her target from up to 3 hexes away. Weak, but it's where most of her mana comes from.

signature._note: The ally lowest on HP% within 3 hexes, Vell included.
signature.name: Mend
signature.text: Heals whichever ally within 3 hexes is lowest on HP, herself included.

passives.name: Hearthlight
passives.text: Every second, heals the other allies within 1 hex of her by a little of their max HP.
